name: mordred-fated-luminary-normal-levelup-into-luminary-draws-two
notes: Mordred, Fated Luminary (KqBosnU7pU): "Mordred can level up into champions of the same base level. When he does, draw two cards." -- the cards are drawn only when Mordred uses that same base level level-up. ENGINE BUG (found, confirmed live, NOT fixed): DoMaterialize() (Custom/MaterializeLogic.php, the "Tristan, Shadowreaver (4upufooz13) ... when she levels up, draw 2" block) draws two cards after EVERY champion level-up whose resulting lineage contains Fated Luminary (ChampionHasInLineage(KqBosnU7pU)), without checking that the level-up was a same base level one -- so an ordinary level 2 -> level 3 level-up of Mordred, Flawless Blade INTO Fated Luminary draws two cards too. The REGRESSION GUARD assertions pin the buggy hand size 10 (7 + 1 turn draw + 2); the rules-correct value is 8.

rulesClauses: When Mordred levels up into a champion of the SAME base level, draw two cards (an ordinary level 2 -> 3 level-up into Fated Luminary is not that).

engineBug.summary: An ordinary level 2 -> level 3 level-up of Mordred, Flawless Blade INTO Fated Luminary draws two cards. DoMaterialize() (Custom/MaterializeLogic.php, the 'Tristan, Shadowreaver ... when she levels up, draw 2 cards' block) draws two after EVERY champion level-up whose resulting lineage contains Fated Luminary (ChampionHasInLineage('KqBosnU7pU')), without checking that the level-up was a same-base-level one. Confirmed live: hand 10 (= 7 + 1 turn draw + 2) after the plain Flawless Blade -> Fated Luminary level-up; the rules-correct hand is 8.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/MaterializeLogic.php DoMaterialize(): draw-2 block keyed on ChampionHasInLineage('KqBosnU7pU')
engineBug.verification: Root cause confirmed live with a temporary file trace (restored afterwards): the draw-2 block ran with leveled-INTO=KqBosnU7pU (an ordinary level 2 -> 3 level-up, lineage [Flawless Blade, Burnished Avenger, Spirit of Water]). Break/restore: skipping the draw when the NEW champion is Fated Luminary itself flipped this guard red (hand 8 instead of 10) while the genuine same-level fixture (Luminary -> Regent) stayed green; restored, shasums verified.
